definition.generated_vehicle_filter: Generated SMARTtype0; generated type replaces tokenized GT type before evaluator update.
definition.ego: Ego type/position/heading/shape fixed and included in vehicle metrics; ego speed generated.
definition.shape_and_speed: All generated vehicle rows contribute; no GT valid-mask deletion; out-of-range values clipped to real source histogram bins.
definition.nearest: All vehicle rows except singleton scenes provide nearest-distance observations.
definition.lat_angle: Official onroad vehicle subset only; lateral/angular feature counts equal.
definition.collision: Generated colliding-vehicle count/total generated-vehicle count ×100; independent of onroad subset.
definition.JSD_units: scipy jensenshannon(p,q)**2 gives true natural-log JSD; native scales10/100. Values audited directly without extra sqrt/squaring.
definition.GT_membership: Matched4096 physical raw-frame GT; full50k matched/full references equal only after actual exact complete membership.
definition.type_accuracy_not_measured: Vehicle-only aggregate reports do not reveal pedestrian/cyclist proportions or complete type distribution/accuracy; never infer these from vehicle counts.
